main_text.l: נָתְשׁוּ destruunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. R. נָתַשׁ [?]
נָתְעַב abominabile visum fuit, vel ב abomina-tus, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & Part. Niph. f. m. R. תָּעַב [?]
נִתְעָה seductus est, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. R. תָּעָה [?]
נֶהֱמוּ commoluntur, Job. 4. 10. pro נֶהֱמוּ [?]; præt. Niph. 3. pl. Rad. נָהַם [?]
וְנִתְעֹרְדוּ & erecti consistimus, fut. Hithp. 1. pl. Rad. עָרַד [?]
נִתְעַלְסָה exsultemus, fut. Hithp. 1. pl. parag. Rad. עָלַס [?]
נִתְפַּשׂ captus est, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. Rad. תָּפַשׂ [?]
וְנִתְפְּשֵׂם & apprehendemus illos, fut. Kal, 1. plur. aff. Rad. תָּפַשׂ [?]
נָתוּץ destructum est, præt. Pual, 3. f. m. R. נָתַץ [?]
נָתְצוּ destruxerunt, præt. Kal, נִתְּצוּ destructi sunt, præt. Niph. 3. pl. Rad. נָתַץ [?]
וַיִּתְּצֵם destruxerunt, & destruxistis, præt. Piel, 3. pl. & 2. pl. m. Rad. נָתַץ [?]
נָתַק avellitur, וַיִּתְּקוּ avellebantur, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. Rad. נָתַק [?]
וַיִּתְּקֻהוּ & avellemus eum, Jud. 20. 32. pro נִתְּקֻהוּ, præt. Kal, 1. pl. aff. Rad. נָתַק [?]
לִנְתֹּר ad saliendum, Infin. Piel, præf. R. נָתַר [?]
נָתֹר, & נֶתֶר nitrum, No. f. m. R. נָתַר [?]
נִתְרָאֶה videamus nos, fut. Hithp. 1. pl. R. רָאָה [?]
וַנְּתַשְׁתִּים exstirpavi eos, præt. Kal, 1. sing. aff. præf. Rad. נָתַשׁ [?]
נָתַתִּי & נְתַתָּה dedi, נְתַתֶּם dedistis, נְתַתִּיס dedistis, &c. præt. [?]

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek letters are transcribed from the scan and are uncertain throughout; most Hebrew words are marked [?] for checking against a Hebrew source. The Latin abbreviations (pl., Rad., præt., fut., Infin., præf., Part., No., &c.) are copied as printed. The running head letters are read roughly. Several Latin words are blurred (for example "destruunt", "consistimus", "exsultemus") and should be checked. The line "præt." at the bottom right is a continuation of the last entry. Column break: the left column ends with "נָתוּץ destructum est", and the right column starts with "נָתְצוּ destruxerunt".
